values.note: Outside fair week, sign up at the fairgrounds office during office hours (Mon-Fri 9am-5pm; closed weekends, and the office asks callers to verify hours in the off-season) or call 989-743-3611 for availability. Fair-week sites go to exhibitors by lottery.

booking.source: https://www.shiawasseefair.com/camping ('Please see the Fairgrounds office for checking in and reservations', 'For general camping, not during Fair Week, sign up in our office during posted office hours', 'Call our office for availability (989) 743-3611', business hours Mon-Fri 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Sat-Sun closed), read 2026-10-22

note: Operated by the Shiawassee County Agricultural Society (private nonprofit, not county government) at 2900 Hibbard Rd, Corunna, between Flint and Lansing. General overnight RV camping outside fair week, April-October 1; fair-week camping is by exhibitor lottery only. Primitive sites besides the electric ones; specializes in group camping/camper rallies and hosts show campers (the camping rules cover barns and horse trailers). Site count not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the fair's camping page: general public camping outside fair week ('just for that get away from the busy hustle of life'), 30/50-amp and primitive sites, dump station, sign-up at the office or by phone 989-743-3611 (matches). Fair week (Aug 8-14, 2027) is exhibitors only, by lottery. No rates, season dates or site count are published; the 'General Camping Rules' PDF is written for show/event campers ('Camping begins at 2:00 pm on the day before your event starts'). Note: dropped the RV Life line and moved the dump-fee detail to facilities. Price rests only on RV Life $$ (commercial-tagged).
flags: Inclusion (cf. 3984 Mason County Fairgrounds, dropped): public nightly camping is offered outside fair week, but the fairgrounds posts no camping rate, no season and no site count, check-in is at an office open only Mon-Fri 9-5, and the only camping rules are written for event/show campers. The campground closes to the public for fair week (Aug 8-14, 2027; exhibitor lottery only). Price rests only on the RV Life $$ tier. A human should decide whether this is a campground that sells ordinary nights across the season.
